revised_prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: final industrial-design presentation sheet for a buildable Raspberry Pi 5 music workstation enclosure
Primary request: Create exactly one polished coherent product-design image showing ONE selected compact desktop enclosure design, not alternate concepts. The product is a compact wedge-shaped digital music console with a landscape touchscreen on the sloped top, the screen plane rising toward the rear at about 28 degrees above the desk. Approximate proportions 214 mm wide x 158 mm deep x 92 mm high at the rear and 34 mm high at the front. The rear body extends downward to a level horizontal base with four small rubber feet.
Composition/framing: One large front-right three-quarter hero view plus two small, clearly subordinate detail insets on the same presentation board: a right-side connector view and a rear view. All views depict the exact same product. White-to-warm-gray studio background, subtle shadows, premium industrial design portfolio presentation, no exploded view.
Subject details: Dark graphite folded-metal inner chassis with a satin charcoal PC-ABS outer bezel, narrow warm walnut-toned side rails, black flush screen bezel. The screen is landscape and shows an abstract dark terminal-style music UI with a 40-column by 13-row visual rhythm: colored tracker cells, meters and compact panels, but NO readable words, logos, or unsupported labels. Across the narrow upper front control strip are exactly eight small square low-profile keycaps with replaceable blank legends; below them is a wide front intake made of five clean horizontal grille louvers spanning most of the width. Keep the intake unobstructed. The right side has one accurately organized recessed native-port opening showing a Raspberry Pi-style group: four USB Type-A sockets in two stacked pairs and one Ethernet RJ45 socket, with adequate surrounding clearance. Do not add analog audio jacks. The rear inset shows one 40 mm exhaust grille high on the rear, a recessed cable bay beside it with one USB-C power plug position and one spare micro-HDMI opening, plus a low cord-relief channel. The exhaust fan itself is behind the grille, not decorative. Show a small rear bumper that preserves exhaust clearance. The main body is solid and restrained, evoking a compact modern digital console with subtle vintage amplified-console warmth, not a sci-fi prop.
Airflow/form cues: Front louvers lead visually into the shallow gap under the display; rear grille is the sole active exhaust. No vents on the port cutout. Product sits level despite tilted main body.
Materials/textures: fine-texture matte graphite powder coat, satin charcoal molded polymer, real wood veneer or convincingly molded walnut side rails, black glass display, silicone feet.
Lighting/mood: neutral softbox studio lighting, realistic material response, restrained warm highlights, mechanically plausible.
Constraints: ONE image file, ONE product design, consistent geometry across all views. No dimension text, no callout labels, no branding, no watermark. Exactly eight buttons. Exactly one rear exhaust grille. Right-side native ports only as four USB-A plus one Ethernet. Rear bay only USB-C power and one micro-HDMI opening visible. Keep all connector shapes and cable clearances plausible. No knobs, no speakers, no 1/4-inch jacks, no duplicate fans, no decorative vents that conflict with airflow, no exposed circuit boards, no impossible floating parts, no alternate colors or variants.
